name: Hinomiya Yuu
source:
She’s an older woman who lives next door to the protagonist and also works as a teacher at his school. With her gentle, laid-back demeanor, she’s very popular with the students.

She’s a master of all household chores and boasts a body worthy of a gravure idol, truly the “ideal older sister” everyone dreams of at least once.

Having looked after the protagonist since he was a child and doting on him like a real younger brother, she’s, of course, more than happy to take care of his needs below the waist as well.

She absolutely adores the protagonist’s penis. With her voluptuous, motherly body, she’ll gently, and at times boldly envelop you.
